notes: TOTP two-factor authentication for the admin login (authenticator codes, single-use recovery codes, encrypted secrets, trusted devices); popup link cards - a markdown text card and a location card with a lazy-loading keyless Google map; a draggable, theme-styled divider element; a search engine visibility toggle; arm64 Docker images built natively for Raspberry Pi and Apple Silicon; and the admin UI in German, Simplified Chinese, and Arabic (full RTL).
